arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Venezuela's counsel argued the FSIA is sui generis and distinct from general jurisdiction.
Helmerich & Payne's counsel argued the test turns on what is in issue in the suit.
Justice Alito compared sovereign immunity to qualified immunity for government officials.
Justice Kennedy noted courts might find immunity after initial jurisdictional findings.
